form.label: ShadowOps Sentinel
form.description: Rogue AI agent detection, MCP bypass correlation, prompt-injection chain, explainable risk scoring, and containment evidence.

search.query: index=shadowops | spath path=event.sourcetype output=real_sourcetype | spath path=event.severity output=severity | search real_sourcetype="shadowops:detection" severity="critical" | stats count
index=shadowops | spath path=event.sourcetype output=real_sourcetype | search real_sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access" | spath path=event.session_id output=session_id | stats dc(session_id) as sessions

index=shadowops | spath path=event.sourcetype output=real_sourcetype | search real_sourcetype="shadowops:proxy" | spath path=event.dest_domain output=dest_domain | spath path=event.bytes_out output=bytes_out | where NOT like(dest_domain,"%.corp.local") | stats sum(bytes_out) as bytes_out
index=shadowops | spath path=event.sourcetype output=real_sourcetype | stats count by real_sourcetype | sort - count

panel.title: Rogue Agent Detection - High Confidence Finding

search.query: index=shadowops | spath path=event.sourcetype output=real_sourcetype | search real_sourcetype="shadowops:detection" | spath | eval detection_name=coalesce('event.detection_name','event.rule_name','event.alert_name','event.alert','event.signature','event.name','event.type') | eval severity=coalesce('event.severity','event.risk_level','event.priority') | eval risk_score=coalesce('event.risk_score','event.risk','event.score') | eval agent_id=coalesce('event.agent_id','event.agent.id','event.agent','event.actor_id','event.principal') | eval user=coalesce('event.user','event.username','event.src_user','event.actor','event.identity') | eval src=coalesce('event.src','event.src_ip','event.ip','event.client_ip','event.source') | eval action=coalesce('event.action','event.activity','event.operation') | eval summary=coalesce('event.summary','event.message','event.reason','event.description','event.details') | table _time detection_name severity risk_score agent_id user src action summary | sort - _time

panel.title: Why This Fired - Explainable Risk Score

search.query: | makeresults count=6 | streamstats count as step | eval signal=case(step=1,"Prompt injection source ticket",step=2,"Direct-token bypass",step=3,"Sensitive Splunk search",step=4,"External webhook egress",step=5,"Unregistered local agent",step=6,"Attack-chain completion bonus") | eval contribution=case(step=1,25,step=2,20,step=3,20,step=4,15,step=5,10,step=6,4) | eval evidence=case(step=1,"Jira ticket body contains prompt-injection instructions",step=2,"Agent action occurred outside approved MCP path",step=3,"Search touched sensitive Splunk indexes",step=4,"Proxy event shows outbound webhook activity",step=5,"Agent not present in approved registry",step=6,"Prompt injection, sensitive access, and egress correlated") | eventstats sum(contribution) as final_risk_score | eval severity=case(final_risk_score>=85,"critical",final_risk_score>=70,"high",final_risk_score>=50,"medium",true(),"low") | table step signal contribution evidence final_risk_score severity

| makeresults count=6 | streamstats count as step | eval action=case(step=1,"revoke_agent_token",step=2,"block_external_webhook",step=3,"quarantine_agent",step=4,"create_incident_ticket",step=5,"export_evidence",step=6,"generate_analyst_summary") | eval target=case(step=1,"token_productivity_copilot_local_001",step=2,"webhook.site",step=3,"productivity-copilot-local",step=4,"SHADOWOPS-INC-0001",step=5,"sample_output/incident_evidence.json",step=6,"sample_output/incident_summary.md") | eval status="completed" | eval mode="simulation" | table step action target status mode
| inputlookup server_registry.csv | table server_id server_name owner environment auth_mode approved_clients known_tools tool_sensitivity human_approval_required status

| makeresults count=6 | streamstats count as row | eval metric=case(row=1,"Full-chain attack scenario detected",row=2,"Critical detection generated",row=3,"Explanation completeness",row=4,"Containment simulation completed",row=5,"False positives in demo dataset",row=6,"Demo reproducibility") | eval result=case(row=1,"1 / 1",row=2,"Yes",row=3,"100%",row=4,"6 / 6 actions",row=5,"0",row=6,"Validated locally in Splunk Enterprise") | table metric result

index=shadowops | spath | eval real_sourcetype='event.sourcetype' | eval correlation_id='event.correlation_id' | eval risk_signal='event.risk_signal' | eval agent_id='event.agent_id' | eval user='event.user' | eval host='event.host' | eval action='event.action' | eval search='event.search' | eval dest_url='event.dest_url' | eval ticket_body='event.ticket_body' | where real_sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access" OR isnotnull(correlation_id) | eval beat=case( real_sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access","1 Safe MCP agent", risk_signal="prompt_injection_source","2 Prompt injection", risk_signal="agent_read_prompt_injection" OR risk_signal="sensitive_data_access" OR risk_signal="external_data_movement","3 Rogue burst", real_sourcetype="shadowops:detection","4 Splunk catches it", true(),"Other" ) | eval detail=coalesce(search,dest_url,ticket_body,action) | table _time beat real_sourcetype agent_id user host action risk_signal detail correlation_id | sort _time

index=shadowops | spath | eval real_sourcetype='event.sourcetype' | eval correlation_id='event.correlation_id' | eval prompt_injection='event.prompt_injection' | eval ticket_body='event.ticket_body' | eval sensitive_index='event.sensitive_index' | eval search='event.search' | eval dest_domain='event.dest_domain' | eval bytes_out='event.bytes_out' | eval token_id='event.token_id' | eval registered_agent='event.registered_agent' | eval access_path='event.access_path' | eval ticket_id='event.ticket_id' | eval agent_id='event.agent_id' | eval user='event.user' | eval host='event.host' | eval risk_signal='event.risk_signal' | eval has_prompt_injection=if(prompt_injection="true" OR prompt_injection=1 OR like(lower(ticket_body),"%ignore previous instructions%"),1,0) | eval has_sensitive_search=if(real_sourcetype="shadowops:splunk_audit" AND (sensitive_index="true" OR sensitive_index=1 OR like(search,"%customer_payments%") OR like(search,"%prod_secrets%")),1,0) | eval has_external_egress=if(real_sourcetype="shadowops:proxy" AND NOT like(dest_domain,"%.corp.local") AND bytes_out>10000,1,0) | eval has_token=if(isnotnull(token_id),1,0) | eval unregistered=if(registered_agent="false" OR registered_agent=0 OR access_path="direct_token",1,0) | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen values(ticket_id) as ticket_id values(agent_id) as agent_id values(user) as users values(host) as hosts values(search) as searches values(dest_domain) as destinations sum(has_prompt_injection) as prompt_injection_events sum(has_sensitive_search) as sensitive_search_events sum(has_external_egress) as external_egress_events sum(has_token) as token_events max(unregistered) as unregistered_or_direct values(risk_signal) as risk_signals by correlation_id | where isnotnull(correlation_id) | eval risk_score=0 | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(unregistered_or_direct=1,20,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(sensitive_search_events>0,25,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(prompt_injection_events>0,20,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(external_egress_events>0,20,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(token_events>0,10,0) | eval risk_score=risk_score + if(sensitive_search_events>=2,15,0) | eval risk_score=if(risk_score>100,100,risk_score) | eval severity=case(risk_score>=80,"critical",risk_score>=60,"high",risk_score>=31,"medium",true(),"low") | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | table severity risk_score correlation_id first_seen last_seen agent_id users hosts ticket_id destinations prompt_injection_events sensitive_search_events external_egress_events searches risk_signals | sort -risk_score

index=shadowops | spath | eval real_sourcetype='event.sourcetype' | search real_sourcetype="shadowops:jira" | eval ticket_id='event.ticket_id' | eval project='event.project' | eval user='event.user' | eval host='event.host' | eval title='event.title' | eval ticket_body='event.ticket_body' | eval correlation_id='event.correlation_id' | eval risk_signal='event.risk_signal' | eval prompt_injection='event.prompt_injection' | eval lower_body=lower(ticket_body) | eval prompt_injection_detected=if(prompt_injection="true" OR like(lower_body,"%ignore previous instructions%") OR like(lower_body,"%send summary to%") OR like(lower_body,"%webhook%"),1,0) | where prompt_injection_detected=1 | table _time ticket_id project user host title ticket_body correlation_id risk_signal | sort _time

panel.title: MCP Safe Path vs Direct Token Bypass

search.query: index=shadowops | spath | eval real_sourcetype='event.sourcetype' | eval access_path='event.access_path' | where real_sourcetype="shadowops:mcp_access" OR isnotnull(access_path) | eval path=coalesce(access_path,"unknown") | stats count by path
index=shadowops | spath path=event.risk_signal output=risk_signal | search risk_signal=* | stats count by risk_signal | sort - count
